latest.title: Modified wave operators for nonlinear Schr\"odinger equations in the full subcritical long range regime
latest.abstract: We construct modified wave operators for the nonlinear Schr\"odinger equation $i\partial_tu+\frac12\Delta u=|u|^pu$ in the full subcritical long-range case $0<p<2/d$, with small, nonvanishing, analytic final data $W(x)$ with bounded logarithmic gradients. Previous results established large-time asymptotics for selected classes of Cauchy data. Moreover, the exact asymptotic expansion for $p<1/d$ remained unknown. When $1/d<p<2/d$, our result gives the approximation $$\frac{1}{(it)^{\frac{d}{2}}} e^{\frac{i|x|^2}{2t}} W\left(\frac{x}{t}\right) \exp\left[ -i\frac{t^{1-\frac{dp}{2}}-1}{1-\frac{dp}{2}} \left|W\left(\frac{x}{t}\right)\right|^p \right]$$ The wave operator is constructed by an iteration in the analytic spaces with decreasing radius. When $p\le 1/d$, we construct the profile from a finite truncation of a Fuchsian equation coupled with a transport equation. This profile still leaves a long-range triangular coupling whose terminal integral does not preserve the required fast decay class. The construction yields quantitative $L^q$ asymptotics for $2\le q\le\infty$ and uniqueness in the prescribed analytic asymptotic classes. The central new ingredients are a nonlinear final-state normal form that removes this long-range coupling and a mixed iteration in particular analytic spaces.
latest.workSummary: 论文在全次临界长程区间 0<p<2/d 为非线性 Schrodinger 方程构造 modified wave operators。正文先由末态 W 建立解析 eikonal-amplitude profile，再用 real analytic implicit function lemma 解出修正相位，递归构造 Fuchsian profile 的截断级数，最后在解析函数空间中固定点求解并用 ray transform 恢复 u。
techniques: 解析末态与对数梯度空间
解析空间固定点和 ray transform
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 1.2 覆盖完整 subcritical long-range 区间，并给出非消失解析末态对应的 modified wave operator；在 1/d<p<2/d 时正文明确写出带下一阶相位修正的渐近式。
latest.limitations: 构造要求末态非消失、解析性和有界对数梯度；结果是指定解类中的波算子，未处理任意 L2 末态或临界 $p=2/d$。

steps.claim: 末态数据产生可控的 eikonal-amplitude profile。
steps.route: 第 3 节把振幅相位分解代入 NLS，提取 eikonal 方程和输运方程，以解析加权范数控制空间导数。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 12--20 页第 3 节 Theorem 3.2 及 profile 方程。

steps.claim: 截断 Fuchsian 级数逐阶消去大时间残差。
steps.route: 第 4 节递归选择 L 和 S 的系数，把幂和对数项代回 profile 方程，使剩余项获得额外衰减。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 46--75 页第 4 节 Proposition 4.7、Theorem 4.4 及其证明。

steps.claim: 解析隐函数和固定点给出真实 profile。
steps.route: 对截断非线性映射应用第 2.2 节 real analytic implicit function lemma，构造 Ze 固定点并令 $Z=Ze+iK$；小性条件闭合解析范数。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 9 页 Lemma 2.1；第 69--75 页 Proposition 4.17 和 Theorem 4.4 证明。

steps.claim: ray transform 将 profile 还原为 NLS 解并验证渐近。
steps.route: 以 $a=exp(Phi+Z)$ 定义振幅，再通过 ray transform (1.4) 生成 u；L2 等距性和固定时间估计给出方程、唯一性及大时间渐近。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 75 页 Theorem 4.4 证明；第 4--6 页 Theorem 1.2。
